description: Thumb-long ivory with a notched crown. A Palemaw bites once; a Diretusk never has to. Both leave these.
lore: [[lore/the_gold_agreement|Gold]] does not divide small enough. Everybody here agrees about gold, which is precisely the trouble: the smallest coin anybody will cut is still worth more than a night's guiding, an hour of somebody's back, or a bed by a fire in weather. So below gold the road runs on teeth.

An ivory of this grade is the unit. Eighteen gold nominal; in practice one favour, and every fire on that road knows the size of a favour without anyone having to set it down. You leave one under the flat stone at a crossing when you owe and cannot stop to pay. There is a crossing on the east road with four under the stone, all of them gone grey. Whoever left them has been back past. Whoever they were for has not.
gm_notes: Small change below gold, and a live prop: the flat stone at the east-road crossing with four grey teeth under it. Whoever they are owed to has not come back that way.
